summary: 66 features and 21 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • proposal-creation: retry optimization and start planning (5c41ac0)
  • chat: convert sessions to proposals with the Hagi skill (d46af6f)
  • built-in-skills: add per-hero skill overrides (1e8ace0)
  • scheduled-plans: persist icon and color metadata (f4d319e)
  • hagi-task: expose localized creation schemas (9cb93a2)
  • frontend-config: add an automatic planning preference (38d7c21)
  • scheduled-plans: include project IDs in occurrence responses (fc03aea)
  • cli-proposals: add daily rewards for CLI-created proposals (a3ea7ae)
  • agent-memory-limit: configure limits for spawned agent CLIs (69418eb)
  • scheduled-plans: store project plans as YAML definitions (2a7db81)
  • monospecs: support repository-level metadata in configs (be2fe92)
  • session-images: accept AVIF background uploads (fd40605)
  • monospecs: support Lucide repository icon references (ba1a3ef)
  • planning-directions: seed visuals for skill-ready CLIs (59cee9f)
  • agent-runtime: pass Hagi context to skill-enabled CLIs (7b23f17)
  • codex-steering: steer active Codex runs safely (59403de)
  • planning-directions: add enhanced visualization prompts (aeb5b0c)
  • preset-task-requirements: accept enabled built-in skills (78cebeb)
  • built-in-skills: enable Copilot and omp skill loading (298299a)
  • daily-achievements: detect existing MonoSpec projects (896884c)
  • built-in-skills: honor availability in CLI launch inputs (3a7431d)
  • built-in-skills: manage availability and CLI launch (f8a47cf)
  • monospecs: preserve typed metadata in management edits (a90e0f7)
  • signalr: define the MessagePack hub wire contract (b741c91)
  • interactive-control: enable missing CLI switches by default (7c29570)
  • openspec-prompts: expand localized Mermaid diagram guidance (d0f96bc)
  • built-in-skills: expose release skills and protect their vault (cdf7072)

HagiCode-org/web

  • statusbar: add TokenMonitor glyphs through level 25 (1c380dc)
  • git: show repository icons in status views (5177527)
  • kanban: add command wall layout controls (b31c10c)
  • session: auto-start planning after optimization (9a96937)
  • scheduled-plans: add appearance and edit-scope controls (3df8322)
  • preset-tasks: expose creation schema endpoints (bdb96c4)
  • skills: add built-in skill detail pages (819a64b)
  • skills: configure hero overrides and proposal conversion (fbb3bb4)
  • about: list HagiCode ecosystem sites (61c486f)
  • statusbar: animate session capacity and active rows (e7108ee)
  • achievements: track proposal creation through the CLI (642e740)
  • scheduled-plans: show an agenda and open plans from header (f37b2f2)
  • config-panel: regroup settings and add memory and phrase tabs (75e68e8)
  • git: limit Super Commit All to available capacity (70e82a9)
  • scheduled-plans: add project-scoped plans and calendars (bb7fb27)
  • tokenmonitor: extend progression through level 25 (d0466e8)
  • kanban: show session heroes in command and matrix views (6f3eccd)
  • monospecs: edit metadata on individual repositories (5b38edf)
  • config-panel: keep panel navigation in Redux state (eb3131c)
  • repository-icons: add theme-aware hashed icon tones (89ac4c3)
  • session-actions: add distinct tones to quick actions (73289a1)
  • settings: accept AVIF session background uploads (5458da1)
  • hagitask: add selectable cat and SVG task icons (9b6d31e)
  • repository-icons: add searchable Lucide repository icons (958ac6b)
  • proposal: add enhanced planning visualization support (36ac3c5)
  • layout: sync archive completion and trim duplicate events (88f866f)
  • hero: explain built-in skill availability reasons (5e335d3)
  • proposal: show task progress across every proposal tab (9cdd50e)
  • session: add phone creation and drawer input controls (69e0e25)
  • conversation: render interactive visualizer fences (476e0e1)
  • settings: add searchable navigation with setting reveals (459b8da)
  • skills: let users toggle built-in skill availability (3ad360e)
  • project: edit MonoSpecs metadata in project settings (4e66938)
  • hero: show built-in skill support in CLI indicators (4f7ed54)
  • session: let the drawer dock steer active runs (ace1442)
  • settings: enable Agent CLI interactive controls by default (06fb669)
  • kanban: add Auto wall tiers and clearer session status cues (6e1905f)
  • kanban: cap multi-project commits by free concurrency (37a8fb5)
  • skills: add a read-only built-in skills category (95a92a7)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompt-guidance: clarify Impeccable skill invocation (6ed2017)
  • community-gallery: preserve task icons from catalog data (778416d)
  • openspec-archive: keep archive runs non-interactive (be4e057)
  • annotation-prompts: clarify feedback parsing and file scope (3087677)

HagiCode-org/web

  • proposal: stack repository choices on phones (92ded0d)
  • kanban: open sessions from blank command tile actions (b40b66d)
  • tokenmonitor: enlarge tier preview touch targets (6949e50)
  • git: reapply repository selection for new auto commits (c1d2b07)
  • conversation: enable steering for active Codex CLI runs (d79c255)
  • kanban: keep monitor wall height stable as tiles change (0afde97)
  • conversation: avoid smooth scrolling while history loads (94dc534)
  • ui: stretch actions across responsive overflow menu rows (076f3d1)
  • drawer: restore mouse text selection inside swipe panels (9788787)
  • kanban: clip animated monitor tiles within their slots (9e317d2)
  • proposal: keep repository cards readable on phones (7ce8c88)
  • kanban: keep tile groups stable during long tool runs (43e7b64)
  • kanban: keep archived sessions off the command wall (68f4c04)
  • session: hide missing codes when the hub sends null (fb74b1b)
  • signalr: decode MessagePack hub payloads at the wire boundary (2444b80)
  • matrix: refine project title and avatar typography (9d3cf0b)
  • proposal: render Mermaid in planning direction previews (0011cdc)
